Bid Summary.value: The Maryland State Treasurer's Office is buying 30 Dell Latitude 5550 laptops (SI# CC7802) and 30 Dell WD22TB4 Thunderbolt 4 docks, with a 3-year extended Dell Limited Hardware Warranty, under bid E20P4600040. Bids are due 2024-06-10 at 14:00 EDT and must be submitted electronically only through eMMA, not by email, fax, mail, or hand delivery. Only Master Contractors under the Desktop, Laptop and Tablet 2015 Master Contract (060B5400007) can bid, and they must be authorized Dell resellers, with a manufacturer or distributor Letter of Authorization possible on request. The laptops must have an Intel Core Ultra 5 125U, 16 GB RAM, a 256 GB SSD, a 15.6" FHD non-touch display and Windows 11 Pro, and must be new, ENERGY STAR certified and Copilot ready. Bidders must include a Mercury Affidavit, a Contract Affidavit and estimated ship dates or lead times per item. Delivery is due within 45 days of award, and invoices go by email within 10 days of delivery with proof of delivery and serial numbers. Questions can go to Tamaira Hawkins at 410-260-7533 or thawkins@treasurer.state.md.us. The term of bid, pre-bid meeting, installation, and bid bond requirements were not found in the documents.
